title: In the Flooding Chambers
text:
Walkthrough

Before you pull the lever, you have to make the crate slide under the trap door, then climb up and open the trap door. Next, pull the lever to start the water flow, and stand on the crate.

After that, you have to jump to the ladder and climb, then run to the cracked crate, and pull it. You should stand on it, and then jump to the next platform before the crate starts to sink.

At this point, there is a checkpoint in the middle of this chapter.

The next thing you should do is run forward, and then jump to the middle platform as you slide down. Open the trap door so that the ball can escape, and then quickly close it as soon as it pops up. Next, you should push the ball to the right, and then quickly climb to the top. Finally, stand on the wooden platform, and move forward to proceed to the next chapter.
